alpha_rules.membership_review: fixed cadence or vacated position; intact weights drift naturally

risk_rules.shadow: Unprotected sparse momentum portfolio, replayed with identical costs and fill rules; each close is observable. Actual account never supplies future values to the shadow.
risk_rules.ema: Exit below EMA(fast)*0.98, recover after 3 closes above EMA(fast)*1.01 and positive 3-session shadow return.
risk_rules.drawdown: Exit on 8% or 12% trailing-20-session shadow drawdown AND below EMA20. Recovery same as EMA20.
risk_rules.overheat: EMA10 or EMA20 damage as above, or shadow NAV > EMA60*1.30 AND one-day loss >3% or 3-day loss >6%. Overheat alarm requires 10-session cooldown; recovery uses the unprotected shadow, not flat cash NAV.
risk_rules.execution: multiply same-close shadow target weights by risk budget (0 or 1), then replay following open; no fills at trigger prices

selection_objective: mean(log(wealth / same_engine_buy_hold_wealth) - 0.75 * max_drawdown - 0.002 * max(0, orders_per_year - 20)); ties fewer fills then smaller candidate index
research_status: All dates already inspected. New authorized retrospective architecture experiment after two rejected families; not pristine holdout. All 48 configurations, unprotected alpha diagnostics, failures and input/source identities must remain. Original economic targets and evidence protocols unchanged.
acceptance: A selected research candidate is not proof of arbitrary-subset or four-reference dominance. No automatic broker orders or leverage.
